build_transformer_sentence_encoder: build a TransformerSentenceEncoder with custom vocab size, embedding dim, and number of encoder layers
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through TransformerSentenceEncoder with token tensors and segment labels
init_bert_params: initialize BERT model weights using normal distribution for linear, embedding, and attention layers
build_embedding_layer: build an embedding layer with specified vocab size, embedding dim, and padding index
freeze_embeddings: freeze token, segment, and position embedding parameters to prevent gradient updates during training
